message:
fix(chunkers): accumulate CFG counts, handle unannotated files in diff reader, and apply formatting

WHY
* CFG metrics (Branch, Loop, Return, Error) were being overwritten by the last file in a chunk instead of being accumulated across all files, leading to incorrect counts.
* Files without AST grammar or labels were being skipped entirely in the annotated diff output, silencing changes from the LLM prompt.
* Inconsistent whitespace, indentation, and structure in chunkers files reduced readability and style uniformity.

WHAT
* Change internal/infra/chunkers/adapter.go to accumulate CFG counts across all files in a chunk.
* Modify internal/infra/chunkers/diff_reader.go to include unannotated files (without grammar or labels) using the fallback [CHANGED] label.
* Apply standard go fmt formatting (spacing, tab alignments) to all files in the chunkers package (catalog.go, cfg.go, diff.go, unified.go, and corresponding test files).
* Track branch commit execution plans in .git-courer/branches/fix-annotator-bug/commits.json.
